# About USPS

> About USPS provides corporate information, leadership directories, government relations resources, and organizational structure for the United States Postal Service.

About.usps.com serves as the official corporate information hub for USPS, featuring details about the organization's mission, history, leadership team, and strategic priorities including the Delivering for America initiative. The site includes resources for government relations, legal information, and service alerts.

## Key Topics

- USPS (United States Postal Service)
- Postmaster General
- Board of Governors
- Executive Leadership Team
- Delivering for America
- Organizational Structure
- Government Relations
- Postal Reform
- Financial Sustainability
- Leadership
- Postal Services
- Service Alerts
- Congressional Relations
- Universal Service Commitment
- Postal History

## Core Organization

- [Home](https://about.usps.com): USPS homepage with corporate info, careers, and reference materials
- [Who We Are](https://about.usps.com/who): USPS organizational structure, leadership, and governance overview
- [About the United States Postal Service](https://about.usps.com/who/profile): USPS mission, history, and universal service commitment
- [Postal History](https://about.usps.com/who/profile/history): USPS historical overview from Benjamin Franklin to modern era
- [What We Do](https://about.usps.com/what): USPS services, programs, and organizational functions overview

## Leadership & Governance

- [USPS Leadership](https://about.usps.com/who/leadership): USPS leadership structure and executive management overview
- [Members of the Board of Governors](https://about.usps.com/who/leadership/board-governors): Current USPS Board of Governors members and biographies
- [Executive Leadership Team Members](https://about.usps.com/who/leadership/pmg-exec-leadership-team.htm): USPS Executive Leadership Team members and responsibilities
- [USPS Leadership Organization](https://about.usps.com/who/leadership/officers): USPS officer directory and management hierarchy structure

## Government Relations & Policy

- [Government Relations](https://about.usps.com/who/government-relations): USPS government relations and legislative strategy overview
- [Current Priorities](https://about.usps.com/who/government-relations/current-priorities.htm): USPS strategic priorities and Delivering for America plan
- [Key Topics - Government Relations](https://about.usps.com/who/government-relations/resources.htm): USPS fact sheets, policy briefings, and congressional resources
- [Economic Impact Statements](https://about.usps.com/who/government-relations/economic-impact.htm): USPS economic impact data by state and congressional district
- [Contact - Government Relations](https://about.usps.com/who/government-relations/contact.htm): USPS government relations contact information and liaison offices

## Legal & Judicial Affairs

- [Law Department](https://about.usps.com/who/legal): USPS Law Department and legal services overview
- [Judicial](https://about.usps.com/who/judicial): USPS judicial officer and Board of Contract Appeals
- [Board of Contract Appeals Decisions](https://about.usps.com/who/judicial/board-contract-appeals-decisions): USPS Board of Contract Appeals decisions and case database

## Service Alerts & Support

- [Service Alerts](https://about.usps.com/newsroom/service-alerts/welcome.htm): USPS service alerts for postal facility disruptions and delivery status

## Optional

- [Citizens' Stamp Advisory Committee](https://about.usps.com/who/csac): Citizens' Stamp Advisory Committee and stamp selection process
